records.title: 18. 秘鲁Chan Chan保存良好的Chimú精英墓葬平台

claims.zh: 2026年在Chan Chan发现一座大型Chimú墓葬平台，保存至少38名个体及金属、贝壳、石英饰物和武器等随葬品。关于具体位置，两类一手来源的表述并不完全一致：秘鲁文化部新闻稿笼统称发现位于 **Utzh An围墙建筑群内（en el conjunto amurallado Utzh An）**；而主持研究的 Jorge Meneses 在随后接受 Andina 采访时给出了更具体的位置描述——墓葬平台位于**围墙之外、紧贴南墙**。本页采用后者作为具体空间定位，同时保留官方新闻稿的较宽泛表述。Meneses还明确指出，这不是“原封未动”的一次性埋葬，而是**次生墓葬情境**：部分遗骸在死后被家族成员或墓地管理者反复移动和重新安置，但没有系统盗墓迹象。墓中还包括一具较为罕见的伸直葬个体，与Chimú常见的屈肢或坐姿屈肢葬不同。官方和研究团队也提出个别个体可能涉及人祭，但目前仍是待进一步检验的解释。
claims.en: In 2026, archaeologists uncovered a large Chimú funerary platform containing at least 38 individuals together with metal objects, shell, quartz ornaments, weapons and other grave goods. The two principal first-hand sources describe its location at different levels of precision: the Peruvian Ministry of Culture release broadly places the discovery **within the Utzh An walled complex (en el conjunto amurallado Utzh An)**, whereas Jorge Meneses, the archaeologist directing the investigation, later told Andina that the platform lay **outside the enclosure but directly against its southern wall**. This page follows Meneses's more precise spatial description while retaining the broader wording of the official release. Meneses also described the burial as a **secondary funerary context**, not a sealed untouched deposit: some remains had been repeatedly moved and rearranged after death by relatives or cemetery attendants, while there was no evidence of systematic looting. One individual was buried fully extended, an unusual treatment compared with more typical Chimú flexed or seated-flexed burials. Officials and researchers have also raised the possibility that some individuals may represent human sacrifice, but that interpretation remains preliminary.

records.title: 24. 阿拉斯加Shég’ Xdaltth’í’：13,800年前的东白令营地

claims.zh:
Shég’ Xdaltth’í’（遗址号FAI-02043，旧称McDonald Creek）保存三个晚更新世文化层，年代约为13.8、13.0和12.7 ka。最早的C1层包含超过8万件考古材料；研究团队对其中大量遗物进行了三维定位，并识别出炉址、小型土坑、土炉、动物骨骼集中区以及可能的人工遮蔽/居住结构。遗物包括石器、骨针和其他骨器，以及野牛、猛犸象、马、兔、狼和多种鸟类等动物遗存。

66个AMS年代为遗址建立了坚实年代框架。最早文化层中一组带柄、菱形双面器在阿拉斯加中部十分罕见，却与白令陆桥西侧Nikita Lake和Berelekh的同期材料具有明显相似性。研究者因此把这一遗址视为连接白令陆桥东西两侧物质文化的重要证据。
claims.en:
Shég’ Xdaltth’í’ (FAI-02043, formerly McDonald Creek) preserves three Late Pleistocene archaeological components dating to about 13.8, 13.0 and 12.7 ka. The earliest component contains more than 80,000 archaeological specimens and unusually well-preserved spatial patterning, including hearths, a small pit, an earth oven, faunal concentrations and a probable artificial shelter or dwelling area. The assemblage includes lithics, bone needles and other osseous tools together with bison, mammoth, horse, hare, wolf and diverse bird remains.

Sixty-six AMS radiocarbon dates provide a robust chronology. A distinctive set of stemmed, diamond-shaped bifaces in the earliest component is unusual in central Alaska but resembles coeval artifacts at Nikita Lake and Berelekh in western Beringia. The authors therefore identify the site as an important archaeological link across the former Bering Land Bridge.

records.title: 25. 墨西哥San Pablo Huitzo萨波特克10号墓

claims.zh:
10号墓的调查始于2025年：一则匿名举报提醒Centro INAH Oaxaca注意可能的盗掘活动，随后Jorge Bautista Hernández和Gabriela Galicia Moreno开展调查并定位墓室。INAH于2026年1月23日正式公布这一发现。墓位于Cerro de la Cantera，年代约公元600年，后续官方材料将其置于约公元600–900年的晚期古典时代。墓室保存阶梯式石板券顶、灰泥和彩绘装饰。入口处以猫头鹰形象构成大型雕塑元素，鸟喙覆盖或包围一张灰泥塑成并上色的人脸；门楣和门框保存历法名号与人物形象。墓内壁画以赭、白、绿、红、蓝等颜色描绘一列携带copal香料的人物。

目前正在进行陶器、图像学、铭文学和人骨分析。官方报道说明，墓室内只保存少量人骨碎片，墓外发现不同时期的小型陶器；因此关于墓主人身份、使用次数和谱系关系的解释仍未完成。
claims.en:
Investigation of Tomb 10 began in 2025 after an anonymous report alerted Centro INAH Oaxaca to possible looting; archaeologists Jorge Bautista Hernández and Gabriela Galicia Moreno subsequently located the tomb. INAH formally announced the discovery on 23 January 2026. Located at Cerro de la Cantera, the tomb dates to around AD 600; later official reporting places it within the Late Classic period, approximately AD 600–900. The chamber preserves stepped stone roofing, stucco and painted decoration. A large owl motif frames the entrance, with a modeled and painted human face emerging from or covered by the beak. The lintel and jambs preserve calendrical names and human figures, while murals in ochre, white, green, red and blue depict a procession of figures carrying copal.

Ceramic, iconographic, epigraphic and physical-anthropological analyses are ongoing. Official reporting notes that only limited human skeletal fragments survive inside the chamber and that miniature vessels of different periods were found outside it. Interpretation of the tomb occupant, reuse history and dynastic relationships is therefore still incomplete.

records.title: 26. 老挝石缸平原Site 75：多代次生葬的“死亡之缸”

claims.zh:
2022–2024年对Site 75大型Jar 1的完整发掘，在石缸内部发现密集、以肢解遗骸为主的人骨组合。不同骨骼部位给出的最小个体数（MNI）并不相同：左肱骨为14，右股骨和颅骨为19，牙齿给出最高估计37；长骨沿缸壁成束分布，较小、易碎骨骼比例偏低，支持许多个体在其他地点腐解后再被转移进入石缸的次生葬解释。部分头骨与下颌仍保持接近解剖位置，说明实际葬仪过程可能比单一模式更复杂。

8件人骨/牙齿样品获得直接放射性碳年代，整体范围约为cal AD 890–1160；邻近特征中的木炭也落在相近年代。玻璃珠、陶器、铁器和铜合金铃等随葬材料与石缸平原其他葬仪遗址具有联系。
claims.en:
Complete excavation of Jar 1 at Site 75 between 2022 and 2024 revealed a densely packed human skeletal assemblage dominated by disarticulated remains. MNI estimates vary by element—from 14 based on the left humerus to 19 from the right femur and skull—with dentition providing the highest estimate of 37. Bundled long bones along the jar edges and the reduced representation of smaller fragile elements support secondary deposition after decomposition elsewhere, while several closely associated skull-and-mandible sets suggest a more complex funerary sequence than a single uniform practice.

Eight human bone or tooth samples were directly radiocarbon dated, indicating use spanning approximately cal AD 890–1160. Charcoal from a nearby feature falls within a comparable range. Glass beads, pottery, iron objects and a copper-based bell link the assemblage to broader mortuary traditions of the Plain of Jars.

records.title: 28. 加泰罗尼亚Cova de la Font Major：旧石器时代洞穴刻画

claims.zh:
2019年在Cova de la Font Major的Gatoneres de Cal Palletes区域识别出此前长期被忽视的史前刻画。2022年一篇关于东北伊比利亚砾岩洞穴旧石器考古的 *Antiquity* 区域综述已经初步报告Font Major约100个旧石器风格具象刻画；2026年论文则首次对完整组合进行系统发表和年代、图像学分析。研究共记录280个图像单元，其中55个为动物形象，包括马科、山羊类、鹿类、牛科和罕见的熊形象，其余包括大量非具象符号。

以动物图像数量计，Font Major被作者置于伊比利亚地中海沿岸规模最大的旧石器洞穴艺术组合之列。作为比较，东部伊比利亚的Cova Dones已记录110多个图像单元、至少19个动物形象；Font Major目前记录280个图像单元和55个动物形象，明显扩大了这一地区已知洞穴艺术的规模。
claims.en:
Palaeolithic engravings were first recognized in 2019 in the Gatoneres de Cal Palletes sector of Cova de la Font Major, despite decades of tourist visitation. A 2022 *Antiquity* regional review of conglomerate-cave archaeology in north-eastern Iberia had already reported roughly 100 Palaeolithic-style figurative engravings at Font Major; the 2026 paper provides the first systematic presentation, chronological assessment and full analysis of the corpus: 280 motifs, including 55 zoomorphic figures—equids, caprines, cervids, bovids and a rare bear—together with numerous non-figurative signs.

By number of zoomorphic representations, the authors place Font Major among the largest Palaeolithic parietal-art assemblages of Mediterranean Iberia. For comparison, Cova Dones in eastern Iberia has more than 110 recorded graphic units and at least 19 zoomorphs, whereas Font Major currently has 280 motifs and 55 zoomorphic figures, substantially expanding the known scale of cave art in the region.

records.title: 31. Tampa Bay：密西西比移民陶工与技术知识

claims.zh:
Duke、Torvinen和Wallis对58件普通与装饰陶片进行成分、岩相和技术分析，并结合放射性碳年代模型。中子活化分析显示装饰陶器与Tampa Bay本地黏土的化学组成相符，排除了“整器由北方输入”作为主要解释；但装饰陶器与普通地方陶器在制作技术上存在系统差异：前者普遍采用grog掺和、线圈成形和更一致的泥料配方，而且部分grog中含有佛罗里达半岛本地地质环境不常见的云母等成分。

装饰陶器中约80%使用grog，而普通陶器中没有一件采用这种配方。研究者进一步提出，部分装饰陶器所用grog来自有意打碎的旧装饰陶器，并可能保存“祖传”掺和材料。与北方同期密西西比地区普遍使用grog的传统相结合，尤其是约200英里以北Tallahassee Hills大型密西西比土丘中心附近的普遍做法，作者认为最能解释这些差异的是：来自佛罗里达Panhandle/北方密西西比文化圈的陶工迁入Tampa Bay，在当地形成一个掌握专门技术知识的制作社群。

records.title: 32. 塔吉克斯坦Karatau：中亚早期旧石器绝对年代

claims.zh:
研究团队在2021–2023年重新发掘Lakhuti-IV的PC6、PC5和PC4文化层，并结合塔吉克斯坦博物馆保存的历史发掘材料，对3534件石器进行统一技术分析。研究表明三个古土壤层的石器组合高度相似，不支持过去认为从“早期旧石器”逐步演变到“中期旧石器”的简单技术进化序列。

年代学方面，研究综合三条黄土—古土壤剖面的286个释光年代、16组石英^26Al–^10Be宇生核素数据和磁性地层界线，建立概率年龄—深度模型。结果显示Karatau传统在MIS 15开始时出现，在MIS 13和MIS 11繁盛，并在MIS 10开始前后消失，持续约20–25万年。冰期黄土层中石器显著减少，提示气候波动与高原利用强度之间存在联系。
claims.en:
Field campaigns from 2021 to 2023 re-excavated the PC6, PC5 and PC4 horizons at Lakhuti-IV and integrated these new materials with historically excavated collections curated in Tajikistan. Technological analysis of 3,534 artifacts shows strong continuity among the three assemblages and does not support an earlier model of simple directional evolution toward Middle Palaeolithic technology.

Chronologically, the study combines 286 luminescence ages from three loess–palaeosol sections, 16 quartz ^26Al–^10Be measurements and magnetostratigraphic boundaries within probabilistic age-depth models. The Karatau tradition appears around the onset of MIS 15, flourishes during MIS 13 and 11 and disappears around the beginning of MIS 10, spanning roughly 200–250 thousand years. Sparse artifacts in intervening glacial loess suggest strong climatic modulation of occupation intensity.

claims.en:
The 2022 excavation recovered more than 5,000 cultural objects, including 4,708 stone artifacts and 654 ochre/haematite pieces. Excavation extended below the 1985 limit into a newly defined CU2a, confirming deeper artifacts. Although the modeled onset of CU2a lies between about 64 and 55 ka, artifact densities are very low at its base. The authors therefore use the higher-density concentration near the CU2a–CU2b transition and conservatively infer initial activity at ≥55 ± 4 ka.

Between roughly 55 and 37 ka, abundant haematite, grinding stones and lithic activity suggest repeated use for food processing, pigment preparation and possibly social or ceremonial practices. The sequence continues through the last glacial period and into the Holocene, documenting long-term shifts in technology, raw materials and occupation intensity.

records.title: 34. 苏门答腊Bongal：lashed-lug古船与印度洋海上网络

claims.zh:
Bongal材料包括带凸耳船板、木钉、仍可识别的棕榈纤维绑缚、大型quarter rudder，以及一块带Pallava–Grantha文字的木板。技术分析显示这些构件符合东南亚lashed-lug造船传统。伴出的陶器、玻璃、珠饰和钱币等材料进一步表明Bongal参与了公元7–8世纪印度洋海上交换。

作者认定一件长4.38米的quarter rudder（放射性碳校正年代公元656–687年）是目前东南亚**最早可靠测年的舵**，并指出Bongal把lashed-lug传统明确扩展到苏门答腊西海岸。这里的“最早”是作者基于现有已测年材料提出的比较判断。
claims.en:
The Bongal assemblage includes hull planks with carved lugs, wooden dowels, preserved palm-fibre lashings, a large quarter rudder and an inscribed plank in Pallava–Grantha script. Technological analysis places the timbers within the Southeast Asian lashed-lug tradition. Associated ceramics, glass, beads and coins further indicate participation in seventh- to eighth-century Indian Ocean maritime exchange.

The authors identify a 4.38-m quarter rudder, radiocarbon dated to AD 656–687, as the earliest securely dated rudder currently known in Southeast Asia and regard Bongal as a firm archaeological extension of the lashed-lug tradition to Sumatra’s west coast.

It is a major marker of vernacular Austronesian and Southeast Asian shipbuilding, yet early archaeological hull remains are rare. Sumatra’s west coast faces the Indian Ocean directly but has lacked watercraft remains that connect local construction traditions with wider maritime exchange.

Although the modeled onset of CU2a lies between about 64 and 55 ka, artifact densities are very low at its base. The authors therefore use the higher-density concentration near the CU2a–CU2b transition and conservatively infer initial activity at ≥55 ± 4 ka.

Between roughly 55 and 37 ka, abundant haematite, grinding stones and lithic activity suggest repeated use for food processing, pigment preparation and possibly social or ceremonial practices. The sequence continues through the last glacial period and into the Holocene, documenting long-term shifts in technology, raw materials and occupation intensity.

earlier_history.text:
**中文。** 澳大利亚最早人类占据时间一直是全球现代人扩散研究的重要问题。Widgingarri并非2026年首次进入学术文献：此前项目研究已经把该遗址的晚更新世序列追溯到约5万年前；2026年的新田野论文首次系统发表2022年重新发掘结果，并把遗址最早器物存在保守推进到≥55±4 ka。Kimberley是早期Sahul考古的关键区域，但许多早期遗址的年代、地层完整性和器物密度都需要谨慎处理。Widgingarri Shelter 1在1985年已进行发掘，但当时由于巨石阻挡未达到基岩；2022年Arraluli Clan与CABAH合作重新打开旧探方并继续向下发掘。

**English.** The timing and character of the first human occupation of Sahul remain central to global modern-human dispersal research. Widgingarri was not first reported in 2026: earlier project research already described a Late Pleistocene sequence reaching roughly 50 ka. The 2026 field paper systematically publishes the 2022 re-excavation and conservatively extends artifact presence at the site to ≥55 ± 4 ka. The Kimberley is a key region, but early dates must be evaluated carefully against stratigraphic integrity and artifact density. Widgingarri Shelter 1 was first excavated in 1985, when large blocks prevented reaching bedrock. In 2022, the Arraluli Clan and CABAH jointly reopened and deepened the excavation.

Related geoarchaeological and material studies form part of the same re-excavation programme; the 2026 paper explicitly presents the field excavation, chronostratigraphic sequence and stone-artifact assemblages.

importance_context.en: Widgingarri matters less as a contender for an “oldest Australian site” record than as a newly excavated, long-duration and community-governed sequence. The 2026 increment is specifically the conservative extension of artifact presence at Widgingarri Shelter 1 to ≥55 ± 4 ka, not a claim that the Kimberley region as a whole was first occupied at that date. Lithics, grinding stones, ochre, landscape use and a culturally significant rock-art setting can be considered together across deep time.

records.title: 32. 塔吉克斯坦Karatau：中亚早期旧石器绝对年代

claims.zh:
研究团队在2021–2023年重新发掘Lakhuti-IV的PC6、PC5和PC4文化层，并结合塔吉克斯坦博物馆保存的历史发掘材料，对3534件石器进行统一技术分析。研究表明三个古土壤层的石器组合高度相似，不支持过去认为从“早期旧石器”逐步演变到“中期旧石器”的简单技术进化序列。

年代学方面，研究综合三条黄土—古土壤剖面的286个释光年代、16组石英^26Al–^10Be宇生核素数据和磁性地层界线，建立概率年龄—深度模型。结果显示Karatau传统在MIS 15开始时出现，在MIS 13和MIS 11繁盛，并在MIS 10开始前后消失，持续约20–25万年。冰期黄土层中石器显著减少，提示气候波动与高原利用强度之间存在联系。
claims.en:
Field campaigns from 2021 to 2023 re-excavated the PC6, PC5 and PC4 horizons at Lakhuti-IV and integrated these new materials with historically excavated collections curated in Tajikistan. Technological analysis of 3,534 artifacts shows strong continuity among the three assemblages and does not support an earlier model of simple directional evolution toward Middle Palaeolithic technology.

Chronologically, the study combines 286 luminescence ages from three loess–palaeosol sections, 16 quartz ^26Al–^10Be measurements and magnetostratigraphic boundaries within probabilistic age-depth models. The Karatau tradition appears around the onset of MIS 15, flourishes during MIS 13 and 11 and disappears around the beginning of MIS 10, spanning roughly 200–250 thousand years. Sparse artifacts in intervening glacial loess suggest strong climatic modulation of occupation intensity.

earlier_history.text:
**中文。** 中亚位于黎凡特、南高加索、南亚与东北亚之间，是讨论早期人类欧亚扩散不可绕开的通道，但这一地区早期旧石器研究长期受年代学限制。Khovaling黄土高原的多个古土壤层保存丰富石器，苏联时期已提出“Karatau Culture”，但过去主要依靠黄土—古土壤层序和古地磁进行粗略对比，缺少能够与全球海洋氧同位素阶段直接比较的可靠绝对年代。

**English.** Central Asia lies between the Levant, southern Caucasus, South Asia and Northeast Asia and is therefore central to models of early human dispersal across Eurasia. Yet its Early Palaeolithic record has long been constrained by chronology. Rich lithic assemblages in palaeosols of the Khovaling Loess Plateau were grouped historically as the “Karatau Culture,” but their ages depended largely on stratigraphic and palaeomagnetic correlation rather than robust absolute dating.

records.chronological_context: Main Karatau occupations during MIS 15, 13 and 11, broadly Middle Pleistocene / Karatau主要占据对应MIS 15、13与11，中更新世

importance_context.en: The major advance is not simply an older human date. It turns Central Asia from a poorly dated “corridor” into a sequence that can be compared directly with the Chinese Loess Plateau, the southern Caucasus and western Eurasia. The persistence of a stable technological tradition across several interglacials, combined with occupation contraction during colder phases, provides an unusual long-term record of early human responses to environmental change.
importance_context.zh: 这项工作的真正突破不是“发现更早的人类”，而是把中亚从一个年代模糊的迁徙走廊变成可以与中国黄土高原、南高加索和西亚直接比较的考古序列。一个技术传统跨越多个间冰期长期保持稳定，同时在寒冷阶段显著收缩，为讨论早期人群如何应对环境波动提供了罕见尺度的证据。

claims.zh:
10号墓的调查始于2025年：一则匿名举报提醒Centro INAH Oaxaca注意可能的盗掘活动，随后Jorge Bautista Hernández和Gabriela Galicia Moreno开展调查并定位墓室。INAH于2026年1月23日正式公布这一发现。墓位于Cerro de la Cantera，年代约公元600年，后续官方材料将其置于约公元600–900年的晚期古典时代。墓室保存阶梯式石板券顶、灰泥和彩绘装饰。入口处以猫头鹰形象构成大型雕塑元素，鸟喙覆盖或包围一张灰泥塑成并上色的人脸；门楣和门框保存历法名号与人物形象。墓内壁画以赭、白、绿、红、蓝等颜色描绘一列携带copal香料的人物。

目前正在进行陶器、图像学、铭文学和人骨分析。官方报道说明，墓室内只保存少量人骨碎片，墓外发现不同时期的小型陶器；因此关于墓主人身份、使用次数和谱系关系的解释仍未完成。
claims.en:
Investigation of Tomb 10 began in 2025 after an anonymous report alerted Centro INAH Oaxaca to possible looting; archaeologists Jorge Bautista Hernández and Gabriela Galicia Moreno subsequently located the tomb. INAH formally announced the discovery on 23 January 2026. Located at Cerro de la Cantera, the tomb dates to around AD 600; later official reporting places it within the Late Classic period, approximately AD 600–900. The chamber preserves stepped stone roofing, stucco and painted decoration. A large owl motif frames the entrance, with a modeled and painted human face emerging from or covered by the beak. The lintel and jambs preserve calendrical names and human figures, while murals in ochre, white, green, red and blue depict a procession of figures carrying copal.

Ceramic, iconographic, epigraphic and physical-anthropological analyses are ongoing. Official reporting notes that only limited human skeletal fragments survive inside the chamber and that miniature vessels of different periods were found outside it. Interpretation of the tomb occupant, reuse history and dynastic relationships is therefore still incomplete.
